driveFolder.description: Root Drive folder holding footage/ and audio/ subtrees from the shoot.

prePipelineReleaseFolder.description: Path to the pre-prod release package: script.md, storyboard.json, concept-breakdown.xlsx, call-sheet-day-*.pdf, storyboard/v{n}/P*.png.

prePipelineReleaseHash.description: sha256 over the pre-prod release manifest, bound at intake.

audioLed.description: true when the cut follows the VO track (interview, doc); false when picture leads.

footageSource.description: shoot: camera rushes under driveFolder/footage. generated: one AI clip per storyboard panel, generated by the pipeline under driveFolder/footage/generated (a microdrama). Absent means shoot.

generation.description: Only with footageSource generated: how each panel clip is made.

clipSec.description: Seconds per generated clip when the panel names no length. Default 6.

generateAudio.description: Let the model generate ambience with the clip. Default false: the pipeline adds VO and music itself.

workspaceId.description: The 3echo workspace that pays for the clips.

referenceCutPath.description: Optional: path to a reference edit the sequencer should study for pacing.

colourDirection.description: LUT name, grade brief or 'client will grade' — human-declared at intake.
